sloka: मा भूत् स कालो दुर्मेधः पितरम् सत्य वादिनम् ।अवमन्यस्व स्व धर्मेण स्वयम् वरम् उपास्महे ॥१-३२-२१॥
transliteration: mā bhūt sa kālo durmedhaḥ pitaram satya vādinam ।avamanyasva sva dharmeṇa svayam varam upāsmahe ॥1-32-21॥

translations.english: O wicked one, do not dishonour our father who always speaks the truth. He will choose the bridegrooms righteously. Do not invite death (father may be the cause of your death).
